title: Benchmark Comparison: Rule-Based, LLM, RAG, MCP, LOCO RAG, and Proposed System
interpretation: Descriptive comparison of saved pilot runs on a small custom benchmark. These results do not establish statistical significance or prove that MCP or LOCO retrieval alone caused any observed difference.

approaches.limitation: Uses benchmark-specific hand-coded rules, not a general repair system.
One local Qwen call per case; no retries or fallbacks.
The retrieval corpus includes target-case broken metadata/source, allowing self-retrieval.
Single pilot run; two cases failed behavioral evaluation.
Excludes each target case from retrieval. The observed result comes from one 10-case run and does not establish statistical significance or generalization to unseen projects.
Uses the saved proposed-system evaluation snapshot; no experiment was rerun to generate this comparison.

targeted_follow_up.interpretation: A targeted single-case follow-up, not a 10-case benchmark result. Its status must not be compared directly with the overall pass rates.
